segments.title: How did DINO blood last 115M years?
segments.say: How did dinosaur blood traces last a hundred and fifteen million years?

segments.title: Buried fast
segments.say: First, it was likely buried fast, in low oxygen mud.

segments.title: A mineral moved in
segments.say: Then a mineral called hausmannite filled the blood cells.

segments.title: Hidden in its leg bones
segments.say: They sat in tiny canals inside its leg bones.

segments.title: Heme was still inside
segments.sub: A first **chemical proof**, the team says
segments.say: And heme was still inside. A first, the team says.

segments.title: What it could teach us
segments.say: It could show how blood evolved. How active dinosaurs were. And help the search for ancient life.
